kicker_zh: 子宫内膜癌 · JCO Precis Oncol 2026;10:e250108 · 配对研究
title: Self-Collected vs Physician-Sampled CDO1/CELF4 Methylation for EC Detection
title_zh: 自采 vs 医生采样 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化检测子宫内膜癌
subtitle: 142 paired samples — self-collection AUC 0.930 vs physician 0.896 (no difference); CDO1 R=0.79 concordance
subtitle_zh: 142 例配对样本——自采 AUC 0.930 vs 医生采样 0.896（无差异）；CDO1 R=0.79 一致性
authors: He P, Wang Y, Xie N, Liu C, Liu P, Wang L, Yin S, Zhou S, Cai H, Fu C
authors_zh: 何佩璇, 王依杉, 谢念, 刘成泥, 刘沛, 王林海, 尹素月, 周顺娴, 蔡海意, 符淳
source: JCO Precis Oncol 2026;10:e250108 · DOI 10.1200/PO-25-01081
source_zh: JCO Precis Oncol 2026;10:e250108 · DOI 10.1200/PO-25-01081

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: self-sampling could democratize EC detection — but concordance with physician sampling was unproven.
Question: is self-collected cervical CDO1/CELF4 methylation as accurate as physician sampling?
Why it matters: a patient-centered sampling strategy improves access and early detection.
bullets_zh: 空白：自采样可使 EC 检测大众化——但与医生采样的一致性未经验证。
问题：自采宫颈 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化是否与医生采样同样准确？
意义：以患者为中心的采样策略提高可及性与早检率。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective paired cross-sectional (Mar 2024–Feb 2025); Xiangya 2nd Hospital.
Population: 142 hysteroscopy women (33 EC / 109 non-EC); 81 pre- + 59 postmenopausal.
Sampling: Evalyn Brush (self) vs Cervex-Brush (physician) — both CISENDO® tested blinded.
Analysis: Spearman, Bland-Altman, ROC/DeLong.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻性配对横断面（2024.3–2025.2）；湘雅二医院。
人群：142 例宫腔镜女性（EC 33 / 非 EC 109）；绝经前 81 + 绝经后 59。
采样：Evalyn 刷（自采）vs Cervex 刷（医生）——均盲法 CISENDO® 检测。
分析：Spearman、Bland-Altman、ROC/DeLong。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: High concordance: CDO1 R=0.79, CELF4 R=0.76 (P<.001); Bland-Altman no systematic bias.
Accuracy parity: combined AUC 0.930 (self) vs 0.896 (physician) — no statistical difference.
Standout: self CDO1 single-gene AUC 0.967 (1.000 in premenopausal).
vs clinical: ET AUC <0.6; CA125/CEA/HE4 no diagnostic value.
bullets_zh: 高度一致：CDO1 R=0.79、CELF4 R=0.76（P<.001）；Bland-Altman 无系统偏倚。
准确性相当：联合 AUC 0.930（自采）vs 0.896（医生）——无统计学差异。
亮点：自采 CDO1 单基因 AUC 0.967（绝经前达 1.000）。
vs 临床指标：ET AUC <0.6；CA125/CEA/HE4 无诊断价值。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Patient-centered: home/self sampling with laboratory-grade accuracy — expands EC detection reach.
Stage signal: methylation rises with FIGO stage (II < I ΔCt) — supports risk assessment.
Access: especially valuable in underserved regions and screening programs.
bullets_zh: 以患者为中心：居家/自采样具备实验室级准确性——扩大 EC 检出覆盖面。
分期信号：甲基化随 FIGO 分期升高（II 期 < I 期 ΔCt）——支持风险评估。
可及性：对欠发达地区与筛查项目尤其有价值。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Self-sampling works: AUC 0.930, concordant with physician sampling — reliable, non-invasive, patient-centered.
Access + accuracy: methylation self-testing could transform EC detection pathways.
bullets_zh: 自采样可行：AUC 0.930，与医生采样一致——可靠、无创、以患者为中心。
可及 + 准确：甲基化自测可变革 EC 检测路径。

kicker: Endometrial Cancer · Int J Gynecol Cancer 2024;34:1165–1171 · Prospective
kicker_zh: 子宫内膜癌 · Int J Gynecol Cancer 2024;34:1165–1171 · 前瞻
title: DNA Methylation for Screening EC in Premenopausal Women with Abnormal Uterine Bleeding
title_zh: DNA 甲基化筛查绝经前异常子宫出血女性的子宫内膜癌
subtitle: 296 premenopausal AUB women — dual-gene AUC 0.867; +BMI+TVS triple AUC 0.942
subtitle_zh: 296 例绝经前 AUB 女性——双基因 AUC 0.867；+BMI+TVS 三联 AUC 0.942
authors: Zhao X, Yang Y, Fu Y, Lv W, Xu D
authors_zh: 赵行平, 杨艳芳, 傅英钦, 吕卫刚, 徐大宝
source: Int J Gynecol Cancer 2024;34(9):1165–1171 · DOI 10.1136/ijgc-2024-005723
source_zh: Int J Gynecol Cancer 2024;34(9):1165–1171 · DOI 10.1136/ijgc-2024-005723

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: premenopausal AUB is common but EC is rare — invasive workup of all is wasteful; no reliable non-invasive screen exists.
Question: can cervical CDO1/CELF4 methylation screen EC in premenopausal AUB women?
Why it matters: a sensitive screen protects fertility by avoiding needless hysteroscopy.
bullets_zh: 空白：绝经前 AUB 常见但 EC 罕见——全部有创检查浪费资源；缺乏可靠无创筛查。
问题：宫颈 CDO1/CELF4 甲基化能否筛查绝经前 AUB 女性的 EC？
意义：敏感筛查通过避免不必要宫腔镜保护生育力。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: prospective single-center (Nov 2021–Oct 2022); Xiangya 3rd Hospital; histology reference.
Population: 296 premenopausal AUB women (21 EC / 10 EIN / 265 non-disease; 18–55 y).
Methylation: TCT residual cells — CDO1m ΔCt ≤ 8.4 or CELF4m ΔCt ≤ 8.8.
Comparators: BMI ≥25, TVS ET ≥11 mm, CA125.
bullets_zh: 设计：前瞻性单中心（2021.11–2022.10）；湘雅三医院；组织学金标准。
人群：296 例绝经前 AUB（EC 21 / EIN 10 / 非疾病 265；18–55 岁）。
甲基化：TCT 剩余细胞——CDO1m ΔCt ≤ 8.4 或 CELF4m ΔCt ≤ 8.8。
对照：BMI ≥25、TVS ET ≥11 mm、CA125。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Dual-gene: sensitivity 85.7% · specificity 87.6% · AUC 0.867 — above BMI (0.682) and ET (0.743).
Odds ratios: CDO1m OR 64.49 · dual-gene 42.53 · ET≥11 mm 8.41.
Combinations: +BMI AUC 0.929; +ET 0.920; triple (BMI+ET+dual) AUC 0.942.
Subgroup: BMI<25 + dual AUC 0.955; ET<11 mm + dual AUC 0.906.
bullets_zh: 双基因：灵敏度 85.7% · 特异度 87.6% · AUC 0.867——高于 BMI（0.682）与 ET（0.743）。
比值比：CDO1m OR 64.49 · 双基因 42.53 · ET≥11 mm 8.41。
联合：+BMI AUC 0.929；+ET 0.920；三联（BMI+ET+双基因）AUC 0.942。
亚组：BMI<25 + 双基因 AUC 0.955；ET<11 mm + 双基因 AUC 0.906。

panels.title: Clinical value
bullets: Fertility-friendly: non-invasive screen reduces hysteroscopy in young AUB women.
Add-on value: BMI and ET boost AUC — multi-marker screening is best.
Practical: uses leftover cytology sample — no extra procedure.
bullets_zh: 生育友好：无创筛查减少年轻 AUB 女性的宫腔镜。
加值：BMI 与 ET 提升 AUC——多标志物筛查最优。
实用：利用细胞学剩余样本——无额外操作。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Best non-invasive screen: dual-gene AUC 0.867, triple 0.942 — for premenopausal AUB.
Protects fertility: methylation screening avoids needless hysteroscopy in young women.
bullets_zh: 最佳无创筛查：双基因 AUC 0.867，三联 0.942——用于绝经前 AUB。
保护生育力：甲基化筛查避免年轻女性不必要宫腔镜。
